strapiBlog.title: AYS Developers secured a Guinness World Record, hosting over 2,500 real estate professionals in Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: AYS Developers Dubai recently achieved a groundbreaking milestone by hosting the World's Largest Real Estate Training Session in Dubai at the Grand Hyatt Conference & Exhibition Centre.

data.text:
AYS Developers Dubai recently achieved a groundbreaking milestone by hosting the World's Largest Real Estate Training Session in Dubai at the Grand Hyatt Conference & Exhibition Centre. The session, officially monitored by Guinness World Records adjudicators, attracted more than 2,500 attendees, establishing a new global benchmark.

Missed out on the event? Don't worry! Here’s everything you need to know about what happened during this historic training session.

About AYS Developers Training Record

This exceptional event, the AYS Developers training session record, was spearheaded by Dr. Nour ElSerougy, famously known as the Eagle of Real Estate. Attendees were guided through powerful insights into mastering off-plan sales strategies—particularly crucial for burgeoning locations like Dubai Islands, where AYS Developers has strategic expansion plans.

AYS Developers' Guinness World Record achievement highlights the company's innovative approach to luxury real estate.

The collaboration with Al Safi Bank, a pioneering Islamic bank operating from the Astana International Financial Centre (AIFC), added a strategic advantage. Al Safi Bank specializes in ethical, Sharia-compliant financial solutions, reinforcing the event’s global impact and appeal.

Insights from Provident CEO, Loai Al Fakir

Central to the success of the event was the high-level panel discussion featuring influential figures, notably Provident CEO Loai Al Fakir. Loai Al Fakir provided dynamic insights, sharing bold strategies for enhancing success in real estate. His presence emphasized Provident's leadership in the industry and commitment to pioneering real estate innovation and growth strategies.

The significance of this real estate training Guinness World Record in Dubai was amplified by the prestigious collaboration among AYS Developers, Dr. ElSerougy, the Innovation Experts Real Estate Institute, Al Safi Bank, and renowned broadcaster Kris Fade, who hosted the event. The partnership emphasized the region's commitment to growth, knowledge, and sustainable development in real estate.

faqs.question: What Guinness World Record did AYS Developers achieve?

data.answer: The record for the world's largest real estate training session with over 2,500 participants.

faqs.question: When and where was the event held?

data.answer: June 2, 2025, at the Grand Hyatt Conference & Exhibition Centre in Dubai.
Dr. Nour ElSerougy, also known as the Eagle of Real Estate.

faqs.question: What was the main topic covered?

data.answer: Mastering off-plan sales strategies, especially targeting Dubai Islands.
Sonia Waters, Ismael Al Hammadi, Nazish Khan, Loai Al Fakir, Denis Donovan, Spencer Lodge, and Dr. Nour ElSerougy.
